title: FLINT: Fixed-budget Late Interaction
abstract: arXiv:2610.27273v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-vector retrieval models such as ColBERT often outperform single-vector models of comparable scale by matching queries and documents at the token level. However, retaining a vector for every token substantially increases storage requirements and slows retrieval compared to single-vector bi-encoders, limiting their scalability. We introduce FLINT (Fixed-budget Late INTeraction), an architecture that uses attention-based pooling to represent each query and document with a fixed number of embedding vectors. Unlike architectures that pool only document representations while retaining token-level queries, FLINT applies pooling symmetrically to both sides, limiting document storage and the number of vector comparisons needed during retrieval. FLINT achieves comparable ranking effectiveness to the closest baselines on BEIR and outperforms them on several benchmarks with longer and more complex queries, including BrowseComp+, CRUMB, and T

translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.27273v1 公告类型： cross 摘要：以 ColBERT 为代表的多向量检索模型通过在词元级别匹配查询和文档，往往在同等规模下优于单向量模型。然而，为每个词元保留一个向量会显著增加存储需求，并且与单向量双编码器相比会降低检索速度，限制了其可扩展性。我们提出了 FLINT（Fixed-budget Late INTeraction，固定预算后期交互），这是一种利用基于注意力的池化机制，以固定数量的嵌入向量来表示每个查询和文档的架构。与仅对文档表示进行池化而保留词元级查询的架构不同，FLINT 对查询和文档两侧对称地应用池化，从而同时限制了文档存储量以及检索过程中所需的向量比较次数。FLINT 在 BEIR 上取得了与最接近的基线相当的排序效果，并在包含更长、更复杂查询的多个基准测试上超越了它们，包括 BrowseComp+、CRUMB 和 T
tldr: FLINT 提出一种基于注意力池化的架构，将查询和文档对称地压缩为固定数量的嵌入向量，在大幅降低存储开销和检索时的向量比较次数的同时，保持了与多向量模型相当的检索效果。
en_tdlr: FLINT is an architecture that uses attention-based pooling to symmetrically compress both queries and documents into a fixed number of embedding vectors, achieving retrieval effectiveness comparable to multi-vector models while substantially reducing storage and the number of vector comparisons during retrieval.
